correctness.rationale: Exact additive independent upper/lower-cap area and edge-inclusive trace-mean-curvature formulas are analytic in u_i=a_i^2 near 0. Expanding through u^3 and eliminating the area-adjusted radius yields a separable cubic as delta^-3 objective F(x1)+F(x2)+O_C(delta), with F(x)=-sqrt(3)x^2/48+pi sqrt(3)x^3/80, uniform with two derivatives on fixed [0,C]^2. Independent symbolic differentiation gives x*=10/(9pi), F(x*)=-25sqrt(3)/(2916pi^2), F"(x*)=sqrt(3)/24. Compactness confines minima to the unique positive critical point and C2 Hessian positivity yields uniqueness; exchange symmetry forces u1=u2. One-cut restriction halves the gain, the even antisymmetric Taylor expansion supplies the quadratic stiffness. Independent 65-digit evaluation of exact area/radius formulas at delta=0.03,0.015,0.0075 found two-cut cubic ratios 0.9983,0.99917,0.99958, one/two gain ratio tends 0.5, and normalized antisymmetry stiffness tends 1. This is only for the specified shrinking square, not all convex bodies or cuts.
